decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The application for the removal of part of the existing roof of the Old Chapel Tun room and the erection of a new pitched roof extension, as shown on drawing numbers 4303- 09, 10, 11, 15A, 16, 17, 18A, 19, 20A, 21A, 22, and 24, received 13th January 2006, is recommended for approval as it is considered that the roof extension by reason of its size, materials and design would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of the Griffin Brewery, Chiswick. The roof extension, subject to the conditions imposed on this permission, would preserve the character of the Old Chiswick Conservation Area and would not be detrimental to area or to any listed buildings. The development is in accordance with the London Borough of Hounslow's Unitary Development Plan (2003).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - A statement of protection and construction methodologies necessary to preserve the adjacent listed building during demolition and construction works to be submitted, to include a photographic record of the buildings before scaffolding and any demolitions.
Condition : 5 - Details of the junction between the retained and new areas of building to be provided
Condition : 6 - A sample panel indicating bricks, mortar and joint profile to be constructed on site and approved before construction.
Condition : 7 - Details of the fascias and verge construction to be submitted
Condition : 8 - The suggested tinting finish is to be tested on a sample area, following construction, and approved before carrying out on the actual building.
description: Removal of part of the existing roof to the Old chapel tun room. Erection of new pitched roof extension within Old Chiswick Conservation Area.
